messages.subject: For Cristiano Amon | AI, connectivity and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Qualcomm Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Cristiano Amon, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Qualcomm's expansion across AI computing, connectivity, automotive and data-center infrastructure increasingly intersects with governments, strategic technology policy and global partners. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global-affairs strategy and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Qualcomm's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Qualcomm.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
